source: The preset for Ruby on Rails. It reads config/locales YAML files with their top-level locale key, t and I18n.t calls, and lazy lookups.
text: Ruby on Rails 的預設集。它會讀取 config/locales 中以語系鍵作為頂層鍵的 YAML 檔案、t 和 I18n.t 呼叫，以及 lazy lookup。
